name: A Nonconvex Logarithmic Coefficient Domain in VC Dimension Two
statement: The seventeen-state class $C_{17}$ is union closed and ample of VC dimension two. Its coefficient arrays are feasible exactly when $ab+cd>1$, so $\mathcal A(C_{17})\cong\mathbb R^{15}$ while its logarithmic ratio domain is not convex.
proof: Positive-support deletion leaves only three rows at source 30, whose feasibility is equivalent to $ab+cd>1$; all negative systems are always feasible. The two feasible points $(a,c)=(4,1/16)$ and $(1/16,4)$ with $b=d=1$ have infeasible logarithmic midpoint $(1/2,1/2)$.
